results.command: offline extension checks and repository gates
results.detail: Extension boundary self-test and targeted checks passed; handoff, docs, source policy, and whitespace checks also passed.
The unsigned local verification build completed and all 15 configured tests passed for the implementation source set; the subsequent self-test fixture update does not alter product code.
Capture start records the start time, packetizer activity records the latest packet time, stop or natural end clears both fields, and popup diagnostics distinguish no-packet-yet from stale activity.
The extension policy self-test covers a valid fixture with capture timing/activity fields and reports 52 passing cases after updating its fixture to match the new boundary checks.

limitations: This is deterministic user-space diagnostic evidence only; it does not prove physical audio delivery, browser runtime behavior on every host, privacy guarantees beyond the documented anonymous fields, driver behavior, WaveRT behavior, HLK validation, or signing.
The provenance digest binds this manifest to the source set at the reviewed commit; it does not independently attest that declared commands ran.
A previous verification retry hit an unrelated transient compiler database lock in the shared local build directory; the recorded result is from a later clean successful run.
